283590340.description:
A.C. Gilbert Co.
Metal Microscope Set in Hinged Tin Case
Mid-Century, Circa 1950s
Produced by the renowned A.C. Gilbert Company of New Haven, Connecticut, this vintage No. 9 Microscope Set represents an iconic era of mid-century educational science toys. Housed in its original grey enameled hinged metal carry case with lithographed label, the set features a three-turret optical microscope equipped with a Ramsden eye lens and reflector mirror. Accompanying the instrument are period laboratory accessories including chemical specimen vials, slide boxes, and two original instructional booklets from the Gilbert Hall of Science.
Enameled sheet metal carrying case with handle, latch, and internal fold-out specimen rack
Marked "No. 9 GILBERT MICROSCOPE SET" with stated area magnification ratings up to 105,625 times
Includes three-objective microscope, test tubes with vintage reagents, slide container, spot plate, and two booklets ("How to Use the Gilbert Microscope" and "Gilbert Glass Blowing")
Measures approximately 13.75" high by 9.5" wide by 5" deep; weighs 7.0 lbs
Condition:
Vintage used condition. The microscope frame is structurally sound with intact stage clips and focusing knobs. Metal case exhibits surface scuffs, scratches, oxidation spots, and exterior decal wear consistent with age and storage. Chemical tubes show varying fill levels, dried residues, and aged labels; booklets have edge wear, handling creases, and light toning. Partial set with some empty accessory slots.
